scope: example gripper demonstrator in MuJoCo only; not physical validation

method.action_replay: recorded actions replayed from the open keyframe; qpos compared at every control instant
method.continuation: mjSTATE_INTEGRATION captured at t=1.0 s, restored in a fresh MjData, remaining actions applied
